reviewer: Codex semantic review; not human-owner approval or factual verification
checks: Question, answer and citation reading declarations reconciled with candidate IDs.
Current sensitive-pattern exclusions are reapplied after review.
Initial quarantine and ambiguous/incomplete material stay private.
evidence_limitations: This audit checks persisted declarations and source coverage; it does not independently re-read all cards or turn clean keyword scans into approvals.

Initial 382 approvals use legacy reviewed-count, explicit excluded-index decisions and approval reading declarations, rather than a per-card all_front_back_citation_read boolean. Science snapshot matches every front/back/citation character after removing whitespace; the current manifest is exact-hash bound.

The first 175 legacy queue cards use fully_read batch counts without the later explicit front/back/citation boolean; later batch and shard declarations are stronger. Additional release-audit re-reads are recorded separately.
publication: Aggregates only; raw candidate text, excluded IDs and private reasons are not published.
exclusion_note: The initially flagged set includes image attachments and missing text answers, as well as privacy flags; these are overlapping categories. Withholding is not a finding that every excluded card is sensitive.
